line: A finger-long lanternfish climbs half a kilometre in the dark, hides its shadow with its own lights, and turns out to be one of countless animals rising every night.
line_cn: 一条手指长的灯笼鱼摸黑往上游半公里，用自己的光藏起影子；镜头拉远，原来每晚有无数动物和它一起升起。
uses: Things that happen in the dark
One mark to a whole system
Small adventures told in light and shadow

camera.move: a mark cut live, the camera still
camera.serves: a first line, a title, a signature, a correction

camera.move: one continuous log-scale pull from one mark to a whole place
camera.serves: a reveal, a system, a crowd

camera.move: a descent or climb past a scratched ruler
camera.serves: a journey, a countdown, a timeline

camera.move: tracking alongside, specks streaming in parallax
camera.serves: a climb, a chase, a commute

camera.move: from below into hatched light, the subject a black silhouette
split screen, two views on one beat
camera.serves: action and its result, plan and outcome

transitions: Transitions happen inside the medium: a cut line that becomes a divider, a push into a point of light, a pull to a wide shot.
No wipes, no page turns, no white flashes.
labels: Words belong to the drawing: a depth figure beside a scratched ruler, a title cut into the dark. No boxes, no outlines, no drop shadows.

Faces (all OFL): a heavy geometric sans filled with diagonal cuts for titles (Jost 800), a sturdy mono for numbers (IBM Plex Mono SemiBold), a marker-like Chinese face (LXGW Marker Gothic). These are references; any face with the same roles works.
Subtitles sit low left, Chinese above English, cream on the black ground, revealed left to right in about 0.3 s. Cap height ≥ 30 px for anything the viewer must read.
motion: Everything steps on twos: 15 drawings a second at 30 fps. Each drawing reseeds the tremble.
Camera moves and characters move on the same steps; a stepped camera is part of the look, but keep it smooth in time (eased), not jerky in position.
Cuts appear progressively behind the hot point; dye sweeps in behind a brush edge; lights switch on with a short bloom.
Characters: anticipation, a flick, follow-through (2–4 drawing anticipation, big poses held 4–6 drawings).

native_moves.name: Scratch-in
native_moves.does: A line or a whole character cut live behind the hot point.
native_moves.fits: a title; a first diagram line; a character being born; a correction.

native_moves.name: Hatching is light
native_moves.does: A light source is a field of hatching; an uncut shape inside it is a shadow; hatching that fills the shape makes the shadow vanish.
native_moves.fits: a searchlight; being seen; switching something on.

native_moves.name: One mark to a whole place
native_moves.does: A single drawn subject becomes one of thousands of glowing points in one continuous pull, each level of detail appearing only while it suits the frame.
native_moves.fits: a city's population; crowds; networks; "you are not alone".

native_moves.name: Lights on, one by one
native_moves.does: A row of dots each switching on with a bloom and a note.
native_moves.fits: a sequence; a count; a signal; a city at dusk.

native_moves.name: A cut across the horizon
native_moves.does: The scene's key line (a horizon, a road, a timeline) cut from one edge to the other, opening and closing a film.

score.note: hand-made: struck and bowed vibraphone, pizzicato bass, log drum
